column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text in part (template error; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): the 2026-01-27 ruling calls the ability that makes the tokens Shredder's 'last ability', but his last ability is 'Whenever Shredder deals combat damage to a player, that player loses half their life, rounded up.', which makes no tokens; the tokens come from his first ability ('Whenever Shredder attacks a player, for each other opponent, create a token that's a copy of Shredder tapped and attacking that player, except it isn't legendary. ...'), as his other ruling of that day numbers it ('the token copies created by Shredder's first ability'). Likely origin: the copy-effect note of the cards that make token copies of themselves, as on Improvised Arsenal the same day ('In the unusual case where Improvised Arsenal becomes a copy of something else while its second ability is on the stack ...', right for its token ability, its second), with the ordinal not filled in for Shredder. What the ruling says of the tokens agrees with the card and stays cited (tests/rulings/r_p031_token_self_copies.rs); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
